title: Decoding Life's Glitches: New AI Tool FScanpy 1.0.1 Unlocks Genomic Secrets
summary: A breakthrough new machine learning tool, FScanpy 1.0.1, has been released, promising unprecedented accuracy in predicting programmed ribosomal frameshifting sites. This development stands to dramatically accelerate critical research into genetics and disease mechanisms by deciphering complex biological processes with newfound efficiency.
content:
In the intricate dance of life at the cellular level, sometimes a deliberate misstep can be key to survival. That 'misstep' is known as programmed ribosomal frameshifting, a fascinating genetic mechanism where a cell's protein-making machinery intentionally shifts its reading frame, creating diverse proteins from a single stretch of RNA. This process is crucial for everything from viral replication to fundamental cellular regulation, yet predicting where and how these frameshifts occur has long been a monumental challenge for scientists.

Enter FScanpy 1.0.1, a groundbreaking new machine learning-based tool poised to revolutionize this field. Released to the scientific community, this sophisticated algorithm offers a powerful lens into one of biology's most complex puzzles. By leveraging advanced AI, FScanpy can accurately identify and predict these subtle yet significant ribosomal frameshifting sites with a precision previously unattainable through traditional methods.

The implications for medical and biological research are vast. Understanding programmed frameshifting is vital for developing antiviral therapies, as many viruses, including HIV, exploit this mechanism to produce their proteins. Furthermore, it plays a role in various genetic diseases and cell differentiation. With FScanpy 1.0.1, researchers can now efficiently map these elusive sites, potentially uncovering new pathways for drug discovery, improving our understanding of disease progression, and deepening our grasp of fundamental cellular processes.

This release marks a significant stride in the application of artificial intelligence to unlock the deep mysteries of the genome, empowering scientists with an invaluable instrument in their quest to decode life itself.
keyTakeaways: FScanpy 1.0.1 is a new machine learning tool designed to predict programmed ribosomal frameshifting sites.
This AI-driven innovation offers significantly higher accuracy in identifying complex genetic 'missteps' during protein synthesis.
The tool holds immense potential to accelerate research in viral replication, genetic diseases, and fundamental cellular biology.
author: ykongxiang@qq.com

title: Tinubu Declares a New Economic Chapter: Beyond Reforms, Towards Shared Prosperity for Nigerians
summary: President Bola Tinubu announced a significant shift in his administration's economic strategy during Nigeria's 66th Independence Day address, moving past initial tough reforms to prioritize widespread citizen prosperity. This pivot signals a new emphasis on delivering tangible benefits and inclusive growth to alleviate economic pressures on Nigerians.
content:
Nigeria's political and economic landscape witnessed a significant recalibration this Independence Day as President Bola Tinubu unveiled a refreshed agenda. In his 66th Independence Day address, the nation's leader signaled a decisive shift, declaring that the arduous initial phase of economic reforms has concluded, and his administration is now firmly focused on actualizing "shared prosperity" for every Nigerian.

For months, the nation grappled with the immediate aftermath of stringent economic adjustments. Most notably, the controversial removal of fuel subsidies and significant foreign exchange market reforms, while heralded by some as necessary bitter pills for long-term health, inevitably led to heightened living costs and palpable public apprehension. Tinubu's previous pronouncements consistently emphasized the structural integrity these reforms aimed to build, often urging patience.

Now, the narrative is turning a crucial corner. The administration's renewed focus on "shared prosperity" indicates a move towards more direct interventions and policies designed to cushion citizens and foster inclusive growth. This isn't merely a rhetorical flourish; it suggests a pivot towards tangible benefits, potentially through expanded social safety nets, targeted job creation initiatives, strategic investments in key sectors, and concerted efforts to stabilize consumer prices. It represents a promise that the sacrifices made during the reform period will begin to yield discernible fruit for the common citizen.

The challenge, however, remains immense. Translating this lofty aspiration into concrete realities will test the administration's resolve and implementation capacity in the coming months. Nigerians, having weathered a period of economic tightening, will be keenly watching for discernible improvements in their daily lives. This pivot sets the tone for the remainder of Tinubu’s tenure, with the eyes of the nation fixed on the delivery of genuine, widespread prosperity.
keyTakeaways: President Tinubu announced his administration has moved beyond its initial phase of economic reforms.
The new primary focus is on delivering "shared prosperity" to all Nigerian citizens.
This pivot suggests a move towards tangible benefits and inclusive growth after a period of economic adjustments.
author: Punch Newspapers

title: Nordic BioTechs: Why Hiding Their Light Under a Bushel Is Costing Them Investor Gold
summary: Nordic life sciences startups are urged to significantly enhance their global visibility, as international investors caution that a tougher investment landscape is making it harder for these innovative firms to attract crucial funding. With competition for capital intensifying worldwide, a proactive approach to showcasing their unique value propositions is becoming paramount for securing investment.
content:
The vibrant Nordic life sciences sector, a hub of cutting-edge innovation, is facing a critical juncture. Despite a reputation for groundbreaking research and robust healthcare systems, startups in the region are being cautioned by international investors: their ingenuity might be overlooked if they don't significantly amplify their global presence. The message is clear – in an increasingly competitive and cautious financial world, simply being brilliant isn't enough; you also need to be seen.

The global investment landscape has shifted dramatically. High interest rates, persistent geopolitical uncertainties, and a general tightening of venture capital purse strings have created a 'flight to quality' mentality among investors. This means capital is increasingly flowing towards established, highly visible entities or those with extremely compelling, well-articulated propositions that cut through the noise. For Nordic biotechs, this new reality translates into an uphill battle for attention against global behemoths and well-marketed hubs in the US and Asia.

International financiers are not suggesting a lack of innovative potential; rather, they highlight a systemic issue of under-marketing and insufficient proactive outreach. Many Nordic firms, perhaps due to cultural modesty or a focus solely on R&D, aren't effectively communicating their unique strengths and market-disrupting potential on a global stage. To capture vital investment, these companies must proactively engage with international venture capitalists, participate in major industry conferences beyond their regional borders, and master the art of storytelling to articulate their scientific breakthroughs and commercial viability to a broader audience.

Failure to adapt risks isolating these promising ventures from the capital they desperately need to scale, conduct clinical trials, and bring life-saving therapies to market. Conversely, those that embrace a more outward-looking strategy stand to unlock significant funding, propelling their innovations forward and cementing the Nordic region's place as a global leader in biotech. The call to action is urgent: for Nordic life sciences, visibility isn't just a marketing buzzword, it's the lifeline to future success.
keyTakeaways: Nordic life sciences startups must urgently enhance their global visibility to attract international investors.
A tightening global investment landscape, marked by cautious capital and increased competition, makes proactive outreach non-negotiable.
Effective communication of unique value propositions and consistent engagement with global VCs are critical for securing funding and scaling innovation.
author: rapporteur.com

title: Kong's 'Volcano' Erupts: The Quiet Revolution Brewing in AI Agents
summary: Kong Inc. unveiled "Volcano" at the API + AI Summit 2026, signaling a major strategic pivot from its traditional API infrastructure roots to powering the emerging "agent economy." This move positions Kong to become a foundational player in the next generation of AI-driven applications and services.
content:
The buzz at the API + AI Summit 2026 in Los Angeles reached a fever pitch as Kong Inc. took the stage. For years, the company has been an indispensable architect of the digital world, providing the plumbing that allows disparate software systems to communicate seamlessly. But their latest announcement, the introduction of a new platform dubbed “Volcano,” wasn't just another product launch; it signaled a quiet, yet profound, seismic shift.

Volcano marks Kong’s bold leap from merely managing APIs – the standard interfaces for software interaction – to building the foundational infrastructure for the burgeoning "agent economy." This emerging landscape is populated by autonomous AI agents, capable of independent decision-making and task execution. Until now, many AI-native startups have grappled with the complex architectural challenges of building robust, scalable agentic systems, often reinventing the wheel.

Kong's strategic pivot effectively addresses this bottleneck. Volcano aims to provide the robust, scalable, and secure backbone necessary for these intelligent agents to thrive. It’s a move that transforms Kong from an API infrastructure powerhouse into an agent infrastructure pioneer, positioning them at the very heart of the next wave of AI innovation.

This isn't just about a new product; it's about redefining Kong's role in the tech ecosystem. By offering a standardized, resilient infrastructure for AI agents, Volcano could democratize access to sophisticated AI capabilities, empowering a wider array of developers and enterprises to build, deploy, and manage autonomous systems with unprecedented ease. The future of AI, it seems, just got a new bedrock.
keyTakeaways: Kong Inc. has strategically pivoted from API infrastructure to becoming a foundational player in the "agent economy."
The introduction of "Volcano" signifies Kong's commitment to providing the necessary architecture for the next wave of AI-driven agentic applications.
This move aims to streamline the development and deployment of autonomous AI agents, potentially democratizing access for more startups and enterprises.
author: Blair Hayes

title: Pentagon Enlists Tech Titans Musk, Luckey to Forge Future War Strategy
summary: Tech titans Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey, alongside former Speaker Newt Gingrich, are spearheading a new Pentagon initiative called "Project Meridian." Their mission is to identify critical military capabilities, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced weaponry essential for the United States to dominate future conflicts.
content:
In a move signaling a profound strategic pivot, the Pentagon has tapped an unexpected trio of innovators and strategists, including Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, to chart the course for America's future military might. Musk will co-lead "Project Meridian," a high-stakes initiative designed to pinpoint the critical military capabilities, emerging technologies, and cutting-edge weapons systems the United States will need to effectively navigate and win the wars of tomorrow.

Musk isn't riding solo into this defense endeavor. He's joined by Palmer Luckey, the visionary co-founder of defense tech powerhouse Anduril Industries, known for its rapid innovation in autonomous systems and surveillance. Rounding out this formidable leadership team is former U.S. House Speaker Newt Gingrich, whose decades of political acumen and strategic foresight will undoubtedly add a crucial layer of geopolitical context to the technological hunt. This unique collaboration brings together the disruptive force of Silicon Valley, a deep understanding of modern defense challenges, and seasoned governmental experience.

The urgency behind Project Meridian is palpable. As global power dynamics shift and adversaries invest heavily in advanced AI, hypersonic weapons, and sophisticated cyber capabilities, the U.S. military faces an imperative to not just keep pace, but to redefine the battlefield. This initiative is more than just procurement; it's about foresight – identifying the foundational technologies and strategic advantages that will give American forces an undeniable edge in an increasingly complex and contested world.

Project Meridian’s success could reshape the defense industrial base, accelerate the integration of private sector innovation into military applications, and potentially fast-track technologies from labs to the front lines. With Musk's track record of pushing technological boundaries and Luckey's proven ability to deliver cutting-edge defense solutions, the Pentagon is clearly aiming to leapfrog conventional acquisition cycles. The stakes are incredibly high: ensuring America’s technological superiority and strategic resilience for generations to come.
keyTakeaways: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich are co-leading the Pentagon's new "Project Meridian."
The initiative's core mission is to identify essential military capabilities, technologies, and weapons for future conflicts.
This collaboration marks a significant effort to integrate leading private sector innovation with U.S. defense strategy and planning.
author: Anjaly Raj

title: The Theranos Saga Gets the Fielder Treatment as 'You Can See Everything' Premieres
summary: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's highly anticipated documentary, "You Can See Everything," delving into the saga of Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, has officially premiered at the New York Film Festival. The film promises a fresh, potentially unconventional perspective on the notorious Silicon Valley figure.
content:
NEW YORK – The curtain has officially lifted on one of the most intriguing documentary projects in recent memory: "You Can See Everything," the collaborative deep dive into the labyrinthine world of Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, helmed by the uniquely provocative Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. After months shrouded in a whisper network, the film made its highly anticipated debut this Wednesday at the New York Film Festival, drawing considerable buzz and speculation.

For those familiar with Fielder's previous work, from the cringe-comedy masterclass of "Nathan for You" to the deeply existential "The Rehearsal," his involvement signals anything but a conventional true-crime exposé. Paired with Oppenheim, known for his distinct, often surreal cinematic style, the duo promises a perspective on Holmes and the spectacular collapse of her blood-testing empire that is likely to be as disorienting as it is incisive. The very title, "You Can See Everything," feels like a loaded pronouncement in a narrative defined by carefully constructed illusions and widespread deception.

Elizabeth Holmes remains a figure of intense fascination—a Stanford dropout who promised a medical revolution, only to preside over a colossal fraud that captivated Silicon Valley and eventually led to her downfall and incarceration. Documentaries and series have already dissected her story, yet the prospect of Fielder's singular vision applied to this narrative suggests a potential deconstruction unlike any before. Audiences and critics alike are now eager to witness how Fielder and Oppenheim peel back the layers, challenging viewers to confront not just the facts of the Theranos scandal, but perhaps the very nature of perception and storytelling itself. Its premiere marks a significant moment, hinting at a fresh, perhaps unsettling, examination of one of modern tech's most cautionary tales.
keyTakeaways: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's Elizabeth Holmes documentary, titled "You Can See Everything," has officially premiered.
The film made its highly anticipated debut at the prestigious New York Film Festival.
The documentary is expected to offer a unique and unconventional examination of the Theranos scandal, leveraging Fielder's distinctive directorial style.
author: JAKE COYLE AP film writer

title: What Connects Shakespeare, Palladium, and a Sacred Text? The Curious Case of 46
summary: A recent podcast episode from Everything Everywhere unveils the astonishing common thread between the element palladium, William Shakespeare, and a specific biblical psalm. This deep dive explores how the number 46 mysteriously links a precious metal, a literary giant's rumored secret, and a peculiar scriptural observation.
content:
In an age where information overload often obscures genuine curiosity, a recent episode from the podcast *Everything Everywhere* has cut through the noise with a truly fascinating premise: what shared secret could possibly link the lustrous element palladium, the towering literary figure William Shakespeare, and an ancient biblical text? The answer, as it turns out, lies in the unassuming number 46.

Palladium, a shimmering white precious metal, is an indispensable component in everything from catalytic converters to jewelry. Its scientific designation places it firmly as the 46th element on the periodic table, a foundational building block of our universe. This chemical reality, while interesting on its own, takes on a new layer of intrigue when juxtaposed with a centuries-old literary whisper.

The rumor, persistent though unproven, suggests that none other than William Shakespeare secretly contributed to the King James Bible. Specifically, legend has it that he lent his poetic genius to the translation of Psalm 46, perhaps around the age of 46. Further fueling this intriguing speculation is a remarkable textual oddity: if you count 46 words from the beginning of Psalm 46, you land on the word "shake." Conversely, counting 46 words backwards from the end of the psalm reveals the word "spear." A truly stunning coincidence, or a deliberately subtle Easter egg from the Bard himself?

Whether a genuine authorial signature or a cosmic alignment of digits, these revelations from *Everything Everywhere* remind us of the delightful patterns hidden within the fabric of history, science, and literature. They underscore humanity's enduring fascination with uncovering connections in the most unexpected places, proving that sometimes, the most engaging stories are simply waiting for someone to count them out.
keyTakeaways: The element palladium, William Shakespeare, and Psalm 46 are surprisingly connected by the number 46.
Palladium is the 46th element on the periodic table, a precious metal vital in many modern technologies.

A popular rumor suggests Shakespeare contributed to Psalm 46 in the King James Bible, with the words 'shake' and 'spear' appearing precisely 46 words from the start and end of the psalm, respectively.
author: Gary Arndt

title: Proton Charts Course: Automaker Pushes for Malaysia's Electric Future in Budget 2027
summary: Proton has outlined its key proposals for Malaysia's Budget 2027, advocating for a robust, long-term xEV policy to accelerate electric vehicle adoption and solidify the nation's position in the green mobility sector. The automaker also emphasized promoting local sourcing and establishing a nationwide vehicle renewal framework to stimulate economic growth and modernize the automotive landscape.
content:
As Malaysia braces for the tabling of Budget 2027 next Friday, October 9, the nation's automotive giants are making their voices heard. Following the Malaysian Automotive Association (MAA)'s submissions, Proton has now laid out its strategic vision for the country's auto industry, pushing for a future firmly rooted in sustainable growth and technological advancement. Their wishlist presents a cohesive blueprint for a dynamic and future-proof automotive ecosystem.

At the core of Proton's proposals is the urgent need for a long-term xEV policy. This isn't just about offering short-term incentives; it’s a call for a comprehensive national strategy that extends beyond immediate budget cycles. Such a policy would provide the stability and direction necessary to attract investment in charging infrastructure, R&D for electric and hybrid vehicle technologies, and consumer education, ultimately accelerating Malaysia’s transition to green mobility and positioning it as a regional hub for xEV manufacturing.

Beyond the electric revolution, Proton champions the robust promotion of local sourcing. Strengthening the domestic supply chain for automotive components would not only reduce reliance on imports and stabilize costs but also foster the growth of high-value manufacturing jobs. This initiative aims to cultivate a resilient local ecosystem capable of innovating and producing advanced components, thereby enhancing Malaysia's industrial capabilities and economic independence.

Finally, Proton advocates for a structured vehicle renewal framework. This includes mechanisms like scrappage schemes or incentives for consumers to trade in older, less efficient vehicles for newer, safer, and more environmentally friendly models. Such a framework would not only stimulate new car sales and inject vitality into the market but also contribute significantly to improving road safety and reducing the national carbon footprint, modernizing the entire national fleet.

Proton's Budget 2027 wishlist transcends corporate self-interest, painting a picture of a proactive automotive industry player keen on shaping a more sustainable, technologically advanced, and economically vibrant future for Malaysia. It's a strategic push to align national policy with global automotive trends, ensuring Malaysia remains competitive and relevant in the evolving world of mobility.
keyTakeaways: Proton advocates for a long-term xEV policy to provide stability and accelerate Malaysia's transition to green mobility.
The automaker proposes promoting local sourcing to strengthen the domestic automotive supply chain and create high-value jobs.
Proton calls for a vehicle renewal framework, including incentives, to modernize the national fleet, enhance safety, and reduce emissions.
author: Jonathan James Tan

title: Europe's AI Backbone Gets a $120M Boost as DIG Ventures Closes Third Fund
summary: European venture capital firm DIG Ventures has successfully closed its third fund at $120 million, dedicated to investing in early-stage companies building AI-native enterprise and cloud infrastructure. This significant capital infusion aims to empower the foundational technologies underpinning Europe's rapidly expanding artificial intelligence ecosystem.
content:
In a clear signal of burgeoning confidence in Europe's deep tech landscape, DIG Ventures has announced the final close of its third fund, securing an impressive $120 million. This substantial war chest is earmarked for early-stage startups focused on a crucial, often overlooked, segment of the booming artificial intelligence market: AI-native enterprise and cloud infrastructure.

The move comes as the global AI race intensifies, with the underlying "plumbing" becoming as vital as the cutting-edge applications themselves. DIG Ventures isn't chasing the next viral AI chatbot; instead, they're betting on the companies building the robust, scalable, and secure foundations that will enable AI to truly integrate into every facet of business and cloud operations. Think specialized data management, MLOps platforms, AI-optimized compute, and advanced security protocols – the bedrock upon which the future of AI will be built.

Fund III attracted a sophisticated cohort of limited partners, including industry heavyweights such as Horsley Bridge, Sofina, and Granite. Their commitment underscores a shared belief in Europe's potential to produce global leaders in this foundational AI space, moving beyond just consumer-facing applications to the core infrastructure that powers them.

For the continent's ambitious founders, this new fund represents more than just capital; it's a strategic vote of confidence. It provides a vital resource for innovators who are tackling complex technical challenges, helping to nurture a new generation of European tech giants in critical, high-value areas. As AI continues its transformative march across industries, DIG Ventures' latest fund positions itself as a key enabler for Europe to not just participate, but to lead in shaping the future of intelligent infrastructure.
keyTakeaways: DIG Ventures has successfully closed its third fund at $120 million.
The fund will invest in early-stage European startups developing AI-native enterprise and cloud infrastructure.
This capital infusion highlights a strategic focus on foundational AI technologies and strengthens Europe's role in the global AI ecosystem.
author: tech.eu

title: Nokia and Iceye Blast Off with New Sat-Comms Play for Defense and Disaster Response
summary: Finnish giants Nokia and Iceye are joining forces to develop advanced satellite communication systems. This strategic partnership aims to provide critical, secure connectivity for government entities and defense contractors across a spectrum of essential missions, from military operations to rapid disaster relief.
content:
In a move set to redefine critical communications, telecommunications titan Nokia and Finnish new-space trailblazer Iceye have announced a groundbreaking partnership. The two industry heavyweights are combining their formidable expertise to develop a new generation of satellite communication systems specifically tailored for governments and defense contractors, promising unprecedented resilience and security in an increasingly complex world.

Unveiled this past Thursday in Oslo, this collaboration isn't just about putting more satellites in orbit; it's about creating robust, reliable networks for missions where failure simply isn't an option. Their joint venture will support a diverse array of vital operations, spanning everything from enhancing military command and control and bolstering border security, to facilitating crucial communications for emergency services and coordinating swift responses during natural disasters. Imagine a secure, private network available anywhere, anytime – a lifeline for frontline personnel or a crucial data link for remote observation.

Nokia, a name synonymous with global connectivity, brings decades of experience in building resilient, high-performance communication infrastructures. Their deep understanding of private cellular networks and mission-critical solutions will be pivotal in designing systems that can withstand extreme conditions and ensure seamless data flow even in the most challenging environments.

Iceye, on the other hand, is a pioneer in small satellite technology and Earth observation, renowned for its rapid-deployment capabilities and synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) imagery. Their agility in space and expertise in developing compact, powerful satellite constellations provides the crucial orbital backbone for this ambitious project.

This synergy creates a powerful force: Nokia's terrestrial and network intelligence combined with Iceye's cutting-edge space hardware. The resulting satellite systems are poised to offer not just connectivity, but an integrated solution for global security and public safety. As geopolitical landscapes shift and environmental challenges mount, the demand for secure, resilient, and universally accessible communication infrastructure from space has never been higher. This partnership is a clear signal that the future of defense and disaster response is increasingly looking upwards.
keyTakeaways: Nokia and Iceye are partnering to build advanced satellite communication systems for governments and defense.
These systems will support critical missions including military operations, border security, emergency services, and disaster response.
The collaboration merges Nokia's telecom expertise with Iceye's small satellite technology to deliver resilient and secure space-based connectivity.
author: Staff Writer

title: Singapore's Audacious Bid to Anchor the Global Fusion Industry
summary: Singapore is strategically positioning itself as a key player in the burgeoning global fusion energy industry, leveraging its robust talent pool and advanced capabilities in precision engineering, manufacturing, and plasma diagnostics. Despite the long road to commercial fusion, the nation is actively building infrastructure and fostering partnerships to secure a central role in this potentially transformative energy sector.
content:
Imagine a future powered by limitless, clean energy, mimicking the very stars in our sky. This isn't just a distant dream for scientists anymore; it's an ambitious endeavor Singapore is actively championing, positioning itself as a crucial hub in the emerging global fusion energy industry. The Lion City, renowned for its technological prowess and strategic foresight, isn't waiting for commercial fusion to arrive; it's building the foundations for it right now.

While the prospect of commercially viable fusion reactors remains decades away, Singapore’s proactive strategy leverages its existing, formidable strengths. Energy, Trade and Industry Minister Tan See Leng has highlighted the nation’s unique advantage: a deeply cultivated expertise and a robust talent pipeline in areas directly transferable to fusion development. This includes world-class capabilities in precision engineering, advanced manufacturing techniques essential for intricate reactor components, and cutting-edge plasma diagnostics — the very science of understanding the superheated fuel at fusion’s heart.

This isn't merely about theoretical research; Singapore is actively cultivating an ecosystem designed to support and integrate with the global fusion effort. By fostering academic-industrial partnerships and investing strategically in relevant R&D, the nation aims to become a crucial node for manufacturing specialized components, providing expert services, and potentially even hosting pilot projects. It’s a smart play, diversifying its high-tech economy while aligning with global climate goals.

Of course, the path to practical fusion is fraught with immense scientific and engineering hurdles. Yet, Singapore’s bold move isn't just a speculative bet on the future of energy. It’s a testament to its long-term vision for economic resilience and technological leadership, ensuring that when the fusion era inevitably dawns, Singapore will be an indispensable part of its genesis.
keyTakeaways: Singapore is strategically positioning itself to become a key player in the global fusion energy industry, leveraging its established high-tech sectors.
The nation is building on its strong talent pool and expertise in precision engineering, advanced manufacturing, and plasma diagnostics to contribute to fusion development.
Despite fusion's distant commercialization, Singapore is proactively fostering an ecosystem of partnerships and R&D to secure a central role in this future energy sector.
author: Staff Writer
